offering_description.value: Provides cloud-based enterprise work management software for marketing, digital transformation and customer engagement, sold mainly to businesses on subscription. Products include marketing automation, content management, document workflow, knowledge management and customer communications tools. Delivered as hosted software with implementation and support services.

primary_products.value: marketing automation software; project and workflow management software; digital asset and content management software; customer communications software; knowledge management software

primary_services.value: software implementation and professional services; managed services; customer support and training

end_markets.value: marketing and advertising; financial services; healthcare; retail; public sector
